scope: Only read exact frozen five-file TLS deadline slice, source before/after, relevant unchanged ownership/caller code and recorded format/diff evidence. No source edit, Cargo, Windows, SSH, CI or network execution. No R63/main/R64 source or evidence mutation.

findings.subject: one original bare-post interval
findings.fact: Production post wrapper captures Instant::now before socket/OVERLAPPED preparation. checked_add(BUDGET) derives one deadline; only private native-module test clock injection accepts an alternate origin. There is no remote/DTO/application-auth clock parameter or external caller of the injection helper.

findings.subject: pre-native expired preparation
findings.fact: After actual socket preparation but before AcceptEx, an already-due close alarm closes only the exact unsubmitted socket and returns an error. No serial/post/submission/completion charge is invented. A failing close follows existing sticky descriptor retention instead of overwriting/replacing it.

findings.subject: native success or pending versus immediate failure
findings.fact: Immediate non-PENDING error closes only the unsubmitted socket. Native success/PENDING first records the original serial, Pending deadline, submissions and accept_posts, then evaluates late return and cancels. Cancellation sets Closing, retains exact OVERLAPPED/debt and still requires the actual original IOCP packet. No return-time+5s renewal or uncharged successful post exists.

findings.subject: borrow boundaries
findings.fact: The first mutable bare-slot borrow last uses preparation memory before any whole-owner close call; later blocks explicitly reborrow the same slot. Native post uses pinned original operation/address memory. No new pointer lifetime, native buffer movement or unsafe Send/Sync is introduced. This is source reasoning, not a typecheck result.

findings.subject: negative fixed-owner servicing
findings.fact: service_deadlines only scans the one bare owner plus four slots and invokes existing expiry/close operations. It does not dequeue native completion, poll SSPI, return Frame, publish a new positive Head, issue token, submit retirement or rearm. Bare Pending becomes Closing once; business slots become Closed; subsequent sweeps skip the same negative work.

findings.subject: IOCP/frame physical ownership
findings.fact: New sweeps precede each bounded dequeue, surround frame deliveries and precede retire stages. Existing close_slot leaves pending IO and worker-owned Frame charged. Successful queued packets after cancellation still must be dequeued against original pointer/key; exact complete/retire fences remain. A close/service error can fail the caller but is not interpreted as physical debt discharge.

findings.subject: no early or repeated positive re-admission
findings.fact: Only existing complete_bare_accept replenishes its single owner after an actual packet; a canceled pending operation cannot repost. Existing business rearm still requires original token, Closed/socket-invalid/no pending, exact Frame/retired and delivered Closed+Retired events. service_deadlines does not call rearm or reset any deadline.

findings.subject: caller record restoration/error path
findings.fact: The added service after tick_work executes inside the existing Result closure while the record is temporarily taken. self.records[index]=Some(record) occurs before result? propagates any service/maybe_cleanup failure. Other new service calls run before a record is taken or before events are delivered, so they cannot lose that detached record. Existing event and shutdown fault handling remains authoritative.

findings.subject: permissions and request budget
findings.fact: Public TlsHttpHost service_deadlines is negative-only and has no application command/permission input. It cannot admit body, construct session, authorize response or bypass original request token/generation/version/fence checks. Existing Head establishes one120s request interval; new sweeps do not change it or rebase it. Header close reserve25ms and hard5e9ns are unchanged.

findings.subject: finite stage work
findings.fact: Normal active native poll has at most20 service calls; normal Core poll adds at most41 from existing event16/record8/retirement8 bounds. Each scans at most five logical owners. This is a finite user-mode visit bound, not an OS syscall/scheduling/wire-time upper bound. Stopping suppresses positive/expiry work while original drain continues.

findings.subject: new test evidence level
findings.fact: Five added tests call the actual private post helper, actual Winsock/IOCP/dequeue path and existing fake record Driver/mailbox. The pre-expiry test checks unchanged post/completion counts; late-native test checks charged Closing debt and exactly one later packet; direct poll_io test checks due socket close without invented retirement; caller test preserves original Head/admission interval. Controlled origins/clock passages are openly synthetic. No new test was executed by reviewer.
